pages.text: Every $(l:mech/mech)mech$(/l) is built around a $(l)Mech Core$(): a $(l)Fusion Crystal$() set in two Elite Frames. The crystal is end-game work, grown at the end of a chain of machines.

$(li)A running $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l) burns Fuel Rods into Depleted Fuel Rods.$(br)$(li)The $(l:nuclear/waste_reprocessor)Waste Reprocessor$(/l) treats them. $(l)One rod in four$() gives up an $(l:nuclear/isotope_shard)Isotope Shard$(/l).
pages.title: Growing the Fusion Crystal

pages.text: $(li)The $(l:mech/crystallizer)Crystallizer$(/l) grows the shard into a $(item)Fusion Crystal$(), in $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid$(/l) with $(l)4 Amethyst Shards$(), in 30 seconds at 4,000 FE/t.$(br)$(li)$(l:nuclear/isotope_shard)Isotope Shard$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(item)Amethyst Shard$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Fusion Crystal$()
Craft the Fusion Crystal with 2 Elite Frames, 2 Battery Cells and 4 Diamonds. The core then goes into the $(l:mech/mech)Mech Frame$(/l).
pages.title: Making the core
